ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOB = 120^\circ$, $\angle AOC = \frac{1}{3}\angle BOC$, $OM$ bisects $\angle BOC$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOM$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB=120^\circ$, and $\angle AOC= \frac{1}{3} \angle BOC$,\\
thus $\angle AOC= \frac{1}{4} \angle AOB=30^\circ$, and $\angle BOC= \frac{3}{4} \angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
given that OM bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
thus $\angle BOM=\angle COM= \frac{1}{2} \angle BOC=45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOM=\angle AOC+\angle COM=\boxed{75^\circ}$
